messages:
marie: Heads-up — the Console 'Interactive Playground' code sample for tracing hooks is failing in the live doc preview. Getting a 500 on the fetch to /api/trace-example. File: /docs/console/observability/playground.md
jon: Can you paste the error logs? Also which branch/PR preview is this on?
marie: Here's the top of the stack from the preview build log:
```
Error: Cannot read property 'kv' of undefined
at initTrace (/workspace/docs/playground.js:42:15)
```
marie: Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.example
alex: likely fallout from the sdk param rename (tracingKey -> traceKey) in the runtime patch yesterday. I can whip up a small docs PR to update the sample.
pat: let's also update the adjacent cost/latency note — it still says "per 1k tokens" which our style guide requires to be "per 1,000 tokens".
jon: repro steps:
```
curl -sS https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.example/api/trace-example | jq
```
jon: I get the 500 and the same stack. I'll open an issue on the docs repo and attach the log.
deploy-bot: :x: Preview build failed for PR #4321 — Error in playground import path (see CI logs)
alex: ok I'll send PR updating the snippet init to the current SDK:
```
const client = new RedwoodInference({ traceKey: process.env.TRACE_KEY })
```
alex: and I'll update the playground import path from `@redwood/console/playground` -> `@redwood/inference/console-playground`
marie: also spotted the console sidebar link still points to `/console/playground-v1` — can someone change that redirect to `/console/playground`?
pat: @alex @jon please add a short line in the PR description noting the UX wording change for cost units, so product signoff is trivial.
jon: will add a tiny smoke test that runs the snippet with a mock trace object and fails loudly if init throws.
marie: thanks all — ping me when preview rebuilds and I'll verify in the docs preview. :thumbsup:
